description: Energy Injected by Installations with Self-Consumption Generation Units is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset presents the amount of electricity injected into the grid by Self-Consumption Production Units (UPACs), organized by district and municipality. The data refers to registered UPACs, regardless of whether they have a surplus energy sale agreement. Energy injected into the grid corresponds to the energy produced minus the energy self-consumed at the installation. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Renewables, Consumption and Energy. The portal shows 2025-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
